searchText: Great to hear! Where is that picture come from by the way? FOCIL meeting 1 notes! https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1220 Currently, that section of the EIP is misleading. We have a pending [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9381) that fixes it. I do think we need to have it addressed as more and more people found the EIP confusing. I'll make sure we cover this issue in the upcoming breakout. I will check the EIP PR! Will also join the call this Tuesday to listen in 😄 👍
